title: Camp He Ho Ha

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Camp He Ho Ha offers an opportunity for individuals with disabilities to enjoy an adapted recreational experience in a safe and supportive environment. Just as importantly we offer a much-needed break for parents and caregivers. Helping caregivers make an informed decision on summer camp is important to us, as well as equipping returning caregivers with information on how to prepare and what to expect while their camper is at camp. The golden nugget hidden under the original intention of our summer camp is that our overnight programs also give respite to families and caregivers. services.desc: Beyond creating and delivering life-changing summer camps for people living with physical and mental disabilities Camp Health, Hope & Happiness operates a facility rental program during our off-season, March - April and August - October. This program is available to the general public and groups including schools, churches, clubs, organizations, corporations, university groups, and families to access the facility and its services for conferences, retreats, weddings, workshops, seminars and much more.
